text:
incident-bot Service alert: gpu-pool-2 high queue length detected. severity=P2. Investigate.
Alice Chen: paging oncall, seeing a queue spike for hosted/v14-gradual rollout. dashboards show GPU util ~99% and growing.
Mateo Ruiz: confirmed. KV-cache fill rate jumped after today's v14.4 push. queue length metric: inference.queue_length: 8k -> 42k in 7m.
Priya Patel: ouch. Any 503s in logs?
Alice Chen: yes, increased 502/503 rate for some hosted customers, most traffic hitting us at region-us-east1. Error sample: `INFER_ERR: pool_exhausted -> 503`.
Luca Bianchi: looks like prefill/warmup behavior for the new tokenizer variant is creating long context prefills and never hitting KV cache hits, so per-request GPU time doubled.
Mateo Ruiz: posting relevant log lines:
```
2026-03-15T10:18:02Z inference-runtime[worker-45]: req_id=xyz prefill_tokens=12000 kv_cache_miss=true gpu_ms=1420
2026-03-15T10:18:05Z autoscaler: scale_up_attempt pool=gpu-pool-2 desired=30 current=24 reason=capacity_limit
2026-03-15T10:18:09Z autoscaler ERROR: MaxScaleReached pool=gpu-pool-2 max_nodes=30
```
Priya Patel: autoscaler hit the configured max_nodes for that pool. We need to either raise max_nodes (fast) or reduce demand (rollback/traffic-split).
deploy-bot Deploy finished: v14.4 -> 10:12Z (canary->gradual).
Alice Chen: action plan suggestion: 1) open short-term fallback: route hosted traffic to v14.3 (previous) via routing config, 2) temporarily increase pool max_nodes to +10, 3) enable model-level CPU fallback for non-critical requests.
Luca Bianchi: routing change is fastest. redwoodctl routing set-split --model v14 --split 70:30:v14.3,v14.4 ? will that revert canary?
Mateo Ruiz: we can push traffic back to v14.3 100% quickly. Doing that will stop new warmups from v14.4. Will require a quick rollback approval.
Priya Patel: I'm oncall lead, give me 2m to check side effects. Also need CS note if customer-visible.
Support (CS): we already have inbound tickets for timeouts from orgs A and B. Customers seeing elevated latencies 2-10x and some timeouts. Can we provide ETA?
Alice Chen: ETA unknown until we stabilize. Prioritize rollback + scale bump. Mateo, can you try a split to 100% v14.3?
Mateo Ruiz: doing it now: `redwoodctl route set --model v14 --version v14.3 --force`
incident-bot autobot: routing update applied by Mateo Ruiz at 10:21Z.
Mateo Ruiz: monitoring... queue length flattened within 90s, but GPU util still high due to prefill backlog.
Luca Bianchi: I'm going to throttle prefill behavior in runtime: `runtime.config.prefill.max_bytes=256k` and enable kv-cache aggressive warming for existing sessions. Will push patch to runtime config.
Priya Patel: go for it but keep change small.
Alice Chen: I'll request a temporary increase to pool max nodes. Mateo escalate to infra quota?
Mateo Ruiz: filing infra ticket and patching autoscaler: `autoscaler.scale.max_nodes[gpu-pool-2]=40` (manual override). Applied.
incident-bot Notice: autoscaler override applied by Mateo Ruiz.
Support (CS): raising customer comms to impacted orgs, we estimate degraded performance for ~15 minutes.
Priya Patel: verifying metrics: queue length trending down from 42k -> 6k over 6m. 503s dropping. Good.
Luca Bianchi: runtime config change pushed. Prefill trimmed, kv-cache warmup started. Should reduce per-request GPU time by ~55%.
Alice Chen: great. who owns postmortem? I'll take owner, Luca + Mateo as tech leads, Priya as incident lead, Support for customer impact section.
Priya Patel: I'm starting handoff to night oncall in 25m. Will add notes in the incident doc and notify SRE rotation.
Mateo Ruiz: one more note: root cause analysis hypothesis: tokenizer change in v14.4 -> longer, unnecessary prefill sequences and disabled early kv-cache hits, causing per-request GPU time blowup and hitting autoscaler max. Need to add model-level gating to prevent warmup storms on gradual rollouts.
Support (CS): please provide a short blurb we can send to customers: affected endpoints, window, mitigation.
Alice Chen: drafting: "We observed elevated timeouts and latency for hosted inference in us-east1 during a model rollout. We reverted traffic to the previous version and increased infra capacity; service restored to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a detailed postmortem and customer impact summary."
incident-bot Auto-note created: incident-1767894321 (P2) | assigned owners: Alice Chen, Mateo Ruiz | status: mitigation in progress.
Priya Patel: handing off to Luca for overnight monitoring. I'll update rotation and tag next oncall.
Luca Bianchi: ack. I'll keep an eye for rebound and ensure autoscaler settings revert after 2h.
Mateo Ruiz: logging next steps in the incident doc: model rollback, autoscaler override, runtime prefill cap, postmortem timeline.
Alice Chen: TY team. Support, send the blurb and set expectation for a detailed postmortem tomorrow.
Support (CS): sending now.
Priya Patel: last note before handoff: if any new 5xx spikes, page SRE directly and call the escalation number.
Luca Bianchi: noted.
Alice Chen: closing thread summary: immediate mitigation applied (routing -> v14.3, autoscaler override +10 nodes, runtime prefill cap), impact: elevated latency and some 5xx for hosted users in us-east1 between 10:12Z-10:28Z, currently stabilized. Postmortem owner: Alice Chen.
incident-bot Incident status changed: monitoring -> resolved (mitigations stable) at 10:43Z.
